user.title: Choose your recipe folder
user.description: Recipe Wizard reads recipes from a folder of files on your Home Assistant machine. Tell it which folder, and it will check that it can read the recipes before saving.

data_description.recipes_dir: The folder holding your recipe files. Each recipe is one file ending in .json, and folders inside this one are searched too. If you type a name rather than a full path, it is taken as a folder next to your configuration.yaml.

error.directory_not_found: There is no folder at {detail}. Check the spelling, or create the folder and put your recipe files in it.
error.no_recipes: No recipes were found in {detail}. Recipe Wizard looks for files ending in .json, including in folders inside this one.
error.foods_unreadable: Recipe Wizard could not read its own list of foods. That file is part of the integration rather than something you edit, so reinstalling the integration usually fixes it. The error was: {detail}
error.invalid_recipe: One of the recipe files could not be read: {detail}. Fix or move that file, then try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The details are in your Home Assistant log.

foods_unreadable.message: Recipe Wizard could not read its own list of foods: {detail}

invalid_recipe.message: A recipe file could not be read: {detail}

library_not_loaded.message: Recipe Wizard has not finished reading your recipes yet. Try again in a moment.

recipe_not_found.message: No recipe matches "{recipe}". Use the recipe's name, or enough of it to tell it apart from the others.

recipe_ambiguous.message: "{recipe}" matches more than one recipe: {matches}. Say a bit more of the name.

recipe_unresolvable.message: Recipe Wizard could not work out a shopping list for {recipe}: {detail}

computed_item_read_only.message: "{item}" is worked out from your recipe, so its wording cannot be changed here. You can still tick it off, or take it off this list. To change the words, edit the recipe.

item_gone.message: "{item}" is no longer on the shopping list.

set_shopping_list.name: Set shopping list
set_shopping_list.description: Chooses the recipe the shopping list is for, and how many batches of it you are making. Anything you have already ticked off is cleared, because it belonged to the previous list. Items you added yourself are kept.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: The recipe you are shopping for: its name, or enough of the name to pick out just one recipe.

batches.name: Batches
batches.description: How many batches you are making. 1 is one batch of the recipe as written; 2 doubles it, including any sub-recipes it uses.

include_optional.name: Include optional parts
include_optional.description: Turn this off to leave out the parts of the recipe marked optional, such as a sauce that goes with it. Optional ingredients inside a part you are still making are kept, because another part may need the same food.
